messages:
Marie (CS): Heads up — TidalPay renewal flagged by health score. Usage down ~48% last 30d. Advocate Swarna moved to vendor relations, procurement now owned by Liam (CPO).
Tom (AE): Yikes. Any active pilots or open tickets?
Marie (CS): They paused the Dedicated trial on 4/10. No open enablement calls last 2 weeks. Support shows a spike in 500s around 4/8.
Anil (Solutions): I pulled logs — there were auth token failures from their IP range, ~200 failed requests on 4/8-4/9. Query: `SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE status >=500 AND tenant='tidalpay'` returned 198.
Jess (Ops): Noted. No scheduled SRE review on record. Their deployment config is older (v1.2.3) and misses the prefix cache flag we recommended.
Tom (AE): Procurement mentioned competitor demo this morning. Liam is considering a cheaper embedding-first vendor.
Marie (CS): Key risk: lost champion + visible errors = procurement leverage for competitor. We should try salvage playbook.
Tom (AE): Proposed immediate plan (48-72h): 1) Ops triage + hotfix (Anil/Jess) 2) Rescue enablement call with PM + engineering (Marie + Tom) 3) 2-week Dedicated burst with monitoring and cost credit offer 4) Exec QBR invite (VP Sales + CPO)
Jess (Ops): I can run the triage. Will reproduce auth failures, patch, and validate cache flag. ETA for first pass: 24h.
Anil (Solutions): I'll prepare a short runbook + telemetry dashboard (latency, 5xx, cache hit rate). Shareable link for Liam during call.
Tom (AE): For commercial: suggest 20% usage credit for 2 months conditional on committing to renewal by end of quarter. Thoughts?
Marie (CS): Good start. Also capture a short prompt-eval sample showing parity (they care about accuracy vs cost). I'll coordinate with Research to prepare two examples.
Tom (AE): I'll ask Legal for a simple pilot amendment (credit + commit clause).
Jess (Ops): Owners: Ops triage (Jess) — due 24h, Dashboard (Anil) — due 36h, Enablement call (Marie/Tom) — schedule by EOD, Commercial draft (Tom) — due 48h.
Marie (CS): I'll DM Liam to ask for 30m call tomorrow. Call goal: show fixed issues, demo dashboard, present credit and 2-week burst.
deploy-bot: @channel account-update created: TidalPay - rescue-plan-1725006789, assigned to Marie, Tom, Jess, Anil.
Tom (AE): Agree we push urgency. If procurement still leaning competitor after call, escalate to VP Sales for a one-time exec meeting.
Marie (CS): Noted. I'll update CRM stage -> "rescue" and log next steps.
Jess (Ops): Adding the checklist to the ticket. Will post patch notes once deployed. :hammer_and_wrench:
Marie (CS): Thanks — everyone please update thread with progress. Short replies ok. :thumbsup:
